{{Quote|The binary motivator's acting up.|AC-38|<ref name="YT">{{YouTube|video=WUtQfbtAzVA|text=Star Tours 2 queue, droids, and full pre-show video at Disney's Hollywood Studios|channel=@InsideTheMagic|name=Inside the Magic|date=2011-05-20}} {{C|at 5m06s}}</ref>}}
'''Binary motivators''' were [[Motivator/Legends|motivators]] used in [[Starship/Legends|starships]] such as the [[StarSpeeder 1000]], employed by the [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] spaceline. In [[1 BBY/Legends|1]] or [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[AC-38/Legends|AC-38]] assigned [[systems analyst]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] to fix a malfunctioning binary motivator in [[Star Tours Flight 1401]], seeing as the protocol droid understood [[Binary/Legends|binary]].
